param_input_item.param_description: Field size: a scalar for a square field, or a [rows cols] vector.
Complex plane window [xmin xmax ymin ymax].

param_output_item.param_description: Index (1..3) of the root each pixel converged to, or 0 if none.
Iteration count at convergence (basin boundary shading).

description.p: Render the Newton fractal of the polynomial p(z) = z^3 - 1. Each pixel is iterated with Newton's method and colored by which of the three cube roots of unity it converges to; the second output gives the iteration count for shading the fractal basin boundaries. maxiter defaults to 50 and region to [-2 2 -2 2].

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: [root, iter] = tessera.newton(600); imagesc(root); axis image off; colormap(jet(4))
